name: raikiri
notes: OUTPUT MODE png: raikiri has no PDF backend. No crate in the workspace depends on a PDF writer (crates/raikiri/Cargo.toml, crates/raikiri-paint/Cargo.toml: anyrender + anyrender_vello_cpu + png only; grep for pdf finds only test strings). README.md says it 'currently focuses on single-page PNG output' and html_to_png renders the first page only (crates/raikiri/src/html_to_png.rs:1-23). PDF exists only in the separate fulgur repo crate crates/fulgur-raikiri (krilla + published raikiri-html/raikiri-net/raikiri-traits 0.0.6), which is the Fulgur engine, not raikiri. raikiri_html::layout() returns paged DocumentLayout/Page/Fragment (crates/raikiri-html/src/document_layout/mod.rs:182) but requires print media (mod.rs:212-216), so it is not used for screen-mode raster. PIPELINE (modeled on crates/raikiri-wpt/src/screen.rs:22-115, the wptrunner screen renderer): raikiri::parse with ParseOptions.network(FileNetworkProvider).base_url(file://input) (crates/raikiri-html/src/parse.rs:51, types.rs:151-157; crates/raikiri-net/src/file_provider.rs:13) -> effective_document_base_url (parse.rs:514) -> absolutize (copied from crates/raikiri-wpt/src/http_resources.rs:56-78) -> build_rule_tree(..).font_faces_for(screen MediaContext) (crates/raikiri-html/src/cascade.rs:200; crates/raikiri-style/src/ruletree.rs:494; media.rs:70) -> raikiri_dom::build_inline_document_fonts over raikiri_dom::system_font_collection with a file:/data: FontFaceLoader (crates/raikiri-dom/src/fonts.rs:554,765,794) -> Document::set_font_collection (crates/raikiri-dom/src/document.rs:437) -> build_cascaded_with_options(screen, border_width_device_scale=1.0) (cascade.rs:173; crates/raikiri-style/src/cascade/limits.rs:138) -> background/border-image/list-style/::before/::after/@page image prefetch via ImageResolver (copied from crates/raikiri-wpt/src/http_resources.rs:80-196; crates/raikiri-net/src/image_resolver.rs:47) -> prepare_list_marker_images (document.rs:3300) -> raikiri_dom::layout_single_page_with_resolver_and_base_url with PageBox W x H (crates/raikiri-dom/src/layout/page_pipeline.rs:9034) -> anyrender::render_to_buffer:: + raikiri_paint::paint_single_page_with_images_and_warnings (crates/raikiri-paint/src/lib.rs:636) -> premultiplied RGBA composited onto white, PNG via png 0.18 (same Encoder calls as crates/raikiri/src/page_scene.rs:705-728). Raster size checked by raikiri::RasterBufferBudget::reserve_pixels (crates/raikiri/src/raster_budget.rs:67). CPU only (vello_cpu), no GPU. page_rule false: screen-mode raster; --margin-px is ignored per contract. The cascade still evaluates @page for any media type (no media-type check in raikiri-style/raikiri-dom), so an author @page margin would inset the viewport content (raikiri_dom::page_margins, crates/raikiri-dom/src/layout/page.rs:386); @page size does not change the W x H image. default_page_size_config: viewport W x H comes from the args (MediaContext::with_viewport + PageBox). local_resources: is fetched through the provider and its url()/@import resolve against the stylesheet URL (crates/raikiri-html/src/parse.rs:400-440, import.rs:176-189, css_urls.rs:1-21); inline
